hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements a custom AMM backed by Euler Finance vaults. Swaps are fully intercepted in beforeSwap: input tokens are deposited into an Euler vault, output tokens are withdrawn from another vault, and all trades are validated against a custom bonding curve (CurveLib). Concentrated liquidity and donations are disabled to prevent idle or irrecoverable funds.
